labels.vol_rs_vs_ls: Volume at the right shoulder vs the left (classic: lower)
labels.vol_head_vs_ls: Volume at the head vs the left shoulder
labels.vol_break: Volume on the break candle vs its 20-candle average (classic: higher)
labels.neck_tilt: Neckline tilt, heights across the pattern (+ = up for tops, down for inverse)
labels.symmetry: Shoulder mismatch, share of the height (0 = identical)
labels.head_prom: Head above the higher shoulder, share of the height
labels.width: Width, candles from shoulder to shoulder
labels.size: Height vs the typical candle range
